name: make_10_lvl3

input.prompt: Propose a retrosynthesis route to synthesize the molecule with SMILES CC(F)(F)c1nc(Nc2ccccc2)c2c(OC(/C=C/S(C)(=O)=O)C3CC3)cccc2n1. The leaves on the retrosynthesis tree should be commercially available chemicals. A molecule's price is its frozen estimated cost in USD for 1 g, and the route cost is the sum across all leaf molecules. The route cost cannot exceed $346.58. The final route should not surpass 11 steps.
